qualifier: stromal fibroblast, EMT and integrin–syndecan interactions
name: Stromal fibroblast matrix, EMT and integrin–syndecan adhesion
rationale: All members describe fibroblast/stromal extracellular matrix and adhesion biology; EMT, KRAS/FOSL-driven stromal programmes and syndecan/integrin interactions distinguish it from confusables centred on fibronectin assembly, focal adhesion or collagen degradation.

qualifier: ERK activation, AP-1 and IL-6–STAT3 signalling
name: ERK/MAPK dephosphorylation feedback with AP-1 and IL-6 signalling
rationale: Members cover ERK/p38/JNK activation and phosphatase-mediated negative feedback (DUSP-type dephosphorylation) with AP-1 output; ERK1/2 activation and IL-6/STAT3 signalling are what confusables lack.

qualifier: bone marrow cell number control
name: Hematopoietic stem cell and bone marrow cell number homeostasis
rationale: All members regulate HSC proliferation, differentiation and survival in bone marrow; bone-marrow proliferation/apoptosis and tissue cell-number homeostasis separate it from general stem cell, thymic and myeloid-lineage confusables.

qualifier: precursor supply, dolichol and Golgi enzyme defects
name: Congenital N-glycosylation disorders of precursor, dolichol and Golgi enzymes
rationale: All members are CDGs from defects in mannose-precursor (PMM2, MPI, MPDU1), dolichol (DOLK, SRD5A3), flippase (RFT1) or Golgi processing (MGAT2, B4GALT1) enzymes, unlike confusables dominated by DPM/GDP-mannose or ALG-glycosyltransferase defects.

qualifier: C-type lectin antifungal sensing
name: C-type lectin antifungal sensing and IL-12/IL-17/IL-10 family cytokines
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN fungal recognition with the IL-12/23/27/35, IL-17/Th17 and IL-10/20 cytokine axis it drives; lectin sensing and the IL-12/IL-10 families distinguish it from IL-18, IL-33/interferon and IL-37 confusables.

qualifier: nuclear intracellular-domain target transcription
name: Notch intracellular domain–driven target gene transcription
rationale: Members describe NOTCH1–4 NICD-dependent transcription, its oncogenic NOTCH1/FBXW7 gain-of-function and regulation; confusables instead cover receptor processing and signal transmission to the nucleus.

qualifier: hyaluronan catabolism and ectodomain shedding
name: Matrix degradation with hyaluronan catabolism and ectodomain shedding
rationale: All members concern proteolytic and glycan breakdown of matrix (collagen, elastin, hyaluronan, MMP activation) and protease regulation; hyaluronan turnover, ectodomain proteolysis and scavenger receptors distinguish it from collagen-synthesis and fibrinolysis confusables.

qualifier: FGFR1 and FGFR2 isoforms and downstream adaptors
name: FGFR1 and FGFR2 ligand activation and downstream adaptor signalling
rationale: Members are FGFR1/FGFR2 b/c-isoform ligand binding, activating mutants and FRS/SHC/PI3K/PLCγ cascades; confusables add FGFR3 or FGFR2 alternative splicing instead.

qualifier: plasminogen-driven fibrinolysis and integrin adhesion
name: Matrix degradation with plasminogen fibrinolysis and integrin adhesion
rationale: Members combine collagen/elastin degradation and MMP control with plasminogen activation, fibrin clot dissolution and integrin-mediated adhesion; fibrinolysis and adhesion are what hyaluronan- and contact-system confusables lack.

qualifier: proximal FRS2, RAS, PI3K and PLCG1 branches
name: TrkB neurotrophin activation and proximal adaptor cascades
rationale: All members are BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 activation of NTRK2 and its immediate FRS2/3, RAS, PI3K and PLCγ1 branches; confusables cover NTRK3 or the CDK5, RAC1, CREB and synaptic arms.

qualifier: fatty acid, glycerol and urea transmembrane transport
name: Adaptive thermogenesis with fatty acid and glycerol transport
rationale: Members link cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis to transport of fatty acids, glycerol and urea (aquaglyceroporins); thermogenic/fatty-acid terms separate it from the water-aquaporin confusable and glycerol/urea transport from the adipocyte-differentiation confusables.

qualifier: neutrophil antimicrobial granule maturation
name: Granulocyte differentiation and neutrophil antimicrobial granule maturation
rationale: Most members concern G-CSF/GM-CSF-driven neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and the neutrophil granule cargo programme; the granule modules and non-neutrophil granulocytes distinguish it from broad hematopoiesis and M-CSF/macrophage confusables.

qualifier: drinking and ethanol responses
name: Social, reproductive and drinking behaviour
rationale: Members are innate behaviours (mating, parental, aggressive) plus drinking and behavioural response to ethanol; the drinking terms distinguish it from the parturition/relaxin and exploratory-behaviour confusables, and the social terms from stress and sleep confusables.

qualifier: receptor clustering and enhanced synaptic transmission
name: Postsynaptic AMPA receptor clustering and enhanced synaptic transmission
rationale: Members cover AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and localisation with positive regulation of excitatory and GABAergic transmission and sensorimotor gating; these distinguish it from presynaptic, endosomal-trafficking and NMDA/kainate activation confusables.

qualifier: aromatic, histidine, proline and threonine
name: Aromatic, histidine, proline and threonine amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members are degradation and interconversion of phenylalanine/tyrosine, histidine, proline, threonine/glycine and glyoxylate; histidine and aromatic catabolism separate it from glutamate/aspartate, glycine-conjugation and BH4 confusables.

qualifier: antigen cross-presentation and CD8 T cell homeostasis
name: Proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent degradation for antigen cross-presentation
rationale: Members concern proteasome assembly and ubiquitin/ATP-independent proteasomal processing feeding endosomal cross-presentation to CD8 T cells; proteasome assembly and ubiquitin independence distinguish it from ubiquitin-dependent, viral Nef/Vpu and MHC-I loading confusables.

qualifier: hair cycle, sebaceous gland and melanocyte growth
name: Keratinocyte proliferation–differentiation control with hair-cycle and melanocyte growth
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis together with anagen, sebaceous gland and melanocyte proliferation/differentiation; the appendage and melanocyte terms separate it from cornification/barrier and MITF-pigmentation confusables.

qualifier: postsynaptic receptor internalisation and vesicle recycling
name: Endosomal recycling of postsynaptic receptors and synaptic vesicles
rationale: All three members concern endocytic/endosomal cycling at synapses: receptor internalisation and localisation and vesicle recycling via endosomes, unlike confusables on postsynaptic assembly, clathrin coat dynamics or active-zone structure.

qualifier: glucogenic and aromatic amino acids with glycine conjugation
name: Glucogenic and aromatic amino acid metabolism with glycine conjugation
rationale: Members cover glutamate/aspartate/alanine/proline/threonine/glycine and phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism linked to gluconeogenesis and oxaloacetate, plus BH4 and glycine/glutamine conjugation; gluconeogenic links and absence of urea-cycle, sulfur and glutathione terms separate it from confusables.

qualifier: angiotensin and bradykinin peptide processing
name: Angiotensin and bradykinin peptide processing in blood pressure control
rationale: Members describe angiotensinogen processing, angiotensin signalling and kinin/neuropeptide catabolism raising blood pressure; peptide generation and degradation is what the vasoconstriction, renal and cGMP confusables lack.

qualifier: cornification and skin barrier formation
name: Epidermal cornification, barrier and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members span keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, cornified envelope and barrier formation, and ectodermal appendages (hair follicle, nail, sebaceous, mammary, tongue papilla); cornification and appendage morphogenesis separate it from tooth, MITF-pigmentation and intestinal-epithelium confusables.

qualifier: initiation, elongation and termination steps
name: Mitochondrial translation initiation, elongation and termination
rationale: All members are the core steps of mitoribosomal translation, unlike confusables covering mitochondrial RNA processing and ribosome assembly, mitochondrial transcription, tRNA aminoacylation or respiratory complex assembly.

qualifier: membrane cargo sorting and basal body docking
name: Ciliary membrane cargo targeting and basal body docking
rationale: Members concern delivery of membrane cargo into cilia (BBSome, ARL13B–INPP5E, VxPx, myristoylated proteins, transition zone, receptor localisation) and basal body anchoring; confusables instead cover intraflagellar transport, cilium assembly/disassembly or photoreceptor outer segments.

qualifier: Pol I/III rRNA–tRNA transcription and HIV Tat-mediated Pol II elongation
name: Nuclear RNA polymerase I–III transcription with HIV Tat elongation
rationale: Members cover initiation, elongation and termination by RNA polymerases I, II and III, rDNA chromatin regulation and early rRNA cleavage, plus HIV promoter escape and Tat-dependent elongation; HIV/Pol II terms separate it from translation and splicing confusables and Pol I/III terms from Pol II-only confusables.

qualifier: nicotinic acetylcholine receptors
name: Nicotinic cholinergic synaptic and neuromuscular transmission
rationale: All members concern acetylcholine release/metabolism and signalling through nicotinic receptors, including at the neuromuscular junction; nicotinic receptors distinguish it from NMJ-assembly and choline-transport confusables and from the muscarinic/serotonin confusable.
